entries.title: A pie shows how much you have read
entries.body: A small pie beside the reading time at the top of articles in your library shows how much of each you have read: a quarter once started, then half, three quarters, and a full disc from 80%, with nothing shown under 5%. It leaves out the parts folded shut when the article opens, and the quiz now does too. Chat describes your progress in the same steps, so 'most or all of it' starts at 80% rather than 87.5%.
